p.s: you have recently had a class discussion about shopping.
Now your english teacher has asked you to write a composition, giving your opinions on : "shopping is not always enjoyable"
In fact, shopping is not always enjoyable because sometimes you want to buy articles but you don't have enough money!
You don't find anything interesting in the shop.
You can hesitate to choose an article.
Which is the best article to take?
The seller can be not very nice and watch you all the time.
You don't find your size or the good color in the article.
The article can be too expensive.
It looks fragil and it could break easily.
Your must test several shops and compare the price, the quality of the articles.
So you must walk all the day or go by car.
And the weather must be fine if you walk in the town.
Shopping is not always enjoyable if there is a lot of people in the shops because you can't move and choose the article and be cool!
